name: How does the purchase process for a pre-construction condo typically work with a real estate agency like yours?

mainEntity.name: How does the purchase process for a pre-construction condo typically work with a real estate agency like yours?

acceptedAnswer.text: The purchase process for a pre-construction condo with our agency, Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution, typically begins with identifying suitable projects based on your investment goals and budget. We then assist you in navigating developer presentations, reviewing floor plans, and understanding the specific terms of the purchase agreement. A critical first-party insight is our specialized knowledge of projects across Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, and Orange Counties, allowing us to guide you to developments with strong investment potential and reputable developers. We help you through the deposit schedule, construction updates, and final closing, ensuring a clear and informed process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our agency guides you from identifying suitable projects to navigating developer presentations, reviewing agreements, and managing the deposit schedule through to closing. Our local market expertise helps identify strong investment opportunities.
